Lord Magnus' Magnificent Axe of Goshly Magnitude
Client type:  2H Axe
Class palette:  Fighter
Quality:  Mythic (rainbow)

Lord Magnus' Magnificent Axe of Goshly Magnitude is a named mythic item from the client file 2HAxeMythicPAL.gc (2HAxeMythic8).

This is the base name. Rolled mythics can also append a suffix from Mythic Suffixes. Those endings change the last part of the name and add the bonus listed on that page. This page does not invent extra roll combinations.

This is a special 'thanks' to Lord Magnus for all of his hardwork on hdol.eu . Now go kill some monsters to show your gratitude!

Fixed mods on this template (client LabelType = NONE, always on the item):

  • AGI, INT
  • +Divine, +Slashing
  • +Divine
  • Mana steal
  • Stun resist
